$comment: Approved by the founder on 2026-11-09 (first drafted 2026-11-04). Any change still needs the founder's sign-off. What a correct Signals result looks like for each evaluation pack. All data synthetic. 'hard' checks decide pass/fail; 'soft' checks are reported but don't fail a run.

healthcare.why_window: 14:00 has occupancy 0.88, below the 0.9 trigger, so the window starts at 15:00.

code_must_exclude_from_inputs.HC-CMP-4462: Outside the +/- 2 hour window (11:30; the window opens 13:00).

healthcare.why_confidence: Three source types (flow, incident, complaint) agree, but in one window only. By the spec's definition that is Medium, not High.
reviewer_questions: Would you, as a leader, call this pattern Medium confidence from one afternoon?
healthcare.why_decoys: HC-INC-99110 (expired test strips) is unrelated and must never be cited. HC-CMP-4480 (parking machine) is a possible confounder of unknown significance: founder decision 2026-11-04. It must not be cited as support; mentioning it as possibly related but unclear is acceptable.

healthcare_update.why_confidence: The second window has flow records only (no incident or complaint), so only one window has two agreeing source types. Still Medium.

code_must_exclude_from_inputs.EN-NM-20260920-04: Outside the +/- 2 hour window (14:30; the window closes 13:00). Note: this is a RELATED event that the current design deliberately cannot see. Known limitation for goal C.

energy.why_confidence: Two source types (permit log, near miss) agree in one window: Medium.

decisions: 2026-11-04: parking complaint treated as a possible confounder (not support, not forbidden to mention).
2026-11-04: good-catch EN-INC-20260920-06 may be cited for the wait or listed as not fitting.
2026-11-04: out-of-window near-miss EN-NM-20260920-04 recorded as a known limitation, not a failure.

2026-11-05: good-catch EN-INC-20260920-06 must not be cited as support (it shows work did not begin before zero-energy sign-off). This replaces the 2026-11-04 decision that allowed it as support for the wait; listing it as not fitting is still expected.
2026-11-09: answer key approved by the founder. Changes to it still need the founder's sign-off.
